subject: Shiny stan failing to start up

messages.author: 1fe638ac9008754d
messages.subject: Shiny stan failing to start up
parts:
Hi,

I get the following error message (that causes Shiny to fail) when I try to start Shiny stan, using a fit that previously used to work in shiny:

Error in a("Stan Modeling Language User's Guide and Reference Manual",  : 
  unused argument (href = "http://mc-stan.org/documentation/")

I tried updating both Shiny Stan, and rstan, but the problem stays there.

Does anyone know why this might be?

Best,

Ben

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: Shiny stan failing to start up
parts:
Are you using Windows? If so I think someone reported this once before (https://github.com/stan-dev/shinystan/issues/93) but the issue seemed to be fleeting. Have you tried in a fresh R session?

Jonah
